Cell formatters for shad_data_table()

Source: R/data-table.R
shad_fmt.Rd

Declarative column formatters passed to shad_col(format=). Each renders a display string while preserving a numeric (or raw) sort key so ordering stays correct.

Usage

shad_fmt_number(digits = 2, big_mark = ",", prefix = "", suffix = "")

shad_fmt_percent(digits = 1)

shad_fmt_date(format = "%Y-%m-%d")

shad_fmt_badge(map)

Arguments

digits

Decimal places.

big_mark

Thousands separator (number formatter).

prefix, suffix

Strings wrapped around the formatted value.

format

A base::strftime() format string (date formatter).

map

A named vector mapping cell values to shad_badge() variants, e.g. c(active = "default", failed = "destructive").

Value

A shad_fmt object (a function of the column vector).

See also

Other shadshiny data table: shad_col(), shad_data_table(), shad_data_table_server(), update_shad_data_table()

Examples

shad_fmt_number(digits = 2, prefix = "$")
#> function (x) 
#> {
#>     num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
#>     disp <- ifelse(is.na(num), NA_character_, paste0(prefix, 
#>         formatC(num, format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = big_mark), 
#>         suffix))
#>     .cell_num(disp, num)
#> }
#> <bytecode: 0x640ed3d2b8b8>
#> <environment: 0x640ed1aceb90>
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "shad_fmt"
shad_fmt_percent(digits = 1)
#> function (x) 
#> {
#>     num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
#>     disp <- ifelse(is.na(num), NA_character_, paste0(formatC(100 * 
#>         num, format = "f", digits = digits), "%"))
#>     .cell_num(disp, num)
#> }
#> <bytecode: 0x640ed1a3aff0>
#> <environment: 0x640ed1a3bd48>
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "shad_fmt"
shad_fmt_date("%b %d, %Y")
#> function (x) 
#> {
#>     d <- if (inherits(x, c("Date", "POSIXct"))) 
#>         x
#>     else as.Date(as.character(x))
#>     disp <- ifelse(is.na(d), NA_character_, format(d, format))
#>     .cell_num(disp, as.numeric(d))
#> }
#> <bytecode: 0x640ed1820220>
#> <environment: 0x640ed181d6c0>
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "shad_fmt"
shad_fmt_badge(c(active = "default", failed = "destructive"))
#> function (x) 
#> {
#>     xs <- as.character(x)
#>     lapply(xs, function(v) {
#>         if (is.na(v)) 
#>             return(NULL)
#>         variant <- if (!is.na(map[v]) && nzchar(map[v])) 
#>             unname(map[v])
#>         else "default"
#>         html <- htmltools::doRenderTags(shad_badge(v, variant = variant))
#>         list(html = html, text = v, sort = v)
#>     })
#> }
#> <bytecode: 0x640ed16c95a8>
#> <environment: 0x640ed16c4fe8>
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "shad_fmt"
